source_text: Requiescit spiritus in sanctis et malus spiritus partes suas agit ubi locus datur. Baptizare in aqua alterius est; super quem videris spiritum descendentem et manentem, ipse est. Spiritus Dei aliquando adest, aliquando recessisse ostenditur. Discernendi sunt spiritus.
pass_a_gloss: Rests spirit in holy-ones and evil spirit parts its acts where place is-given. To-baptize in water of-another is; upon whom you-see spirit descending and remaining, he is. Spirit of-God sometimes is-present, sometimes to-have-withdrawn is-shown. To-be-discerned are spirits.
pass_b_english: The Spirit rests on the holy; an evil spirit plays its part wherever room is given. One baptizes with water; [[he on whom you see the Spirit descending and remaining — that is he >> Bible:John 1:33]]. Scripture shows God’s Spirit sometimes present, sometimes withdrawn. The spirits are to be discerned.
